title: Bill Gates vs Magnus Carlsen
post: The richest man in the world played Magnus Carlsen at chess. Gates had 2 minutes, Magnus had 30 seconds. It lasted 9 moves. Would you have taken the knight? #chess #magnuscarlsen #billgates #chesstok #checkmate

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: The richest man in the world played Magnus Carlsen at chess.
phrases.say: [serious] The richest man in the world... played Magnus Carlsen at chess.

phrases.text: London, January 2014. Magnus has just become world champion.
phrases.say: London, January twenty fourteen. Magnus has just become world champion.

phrases.text: Bill Gates. Number one on the billionaires list.
phrases.say: Bill Gates. Number one on the billionaires list.

phrases.text: On a TV talk show, they sit down for a game of blitz.
phrases.say: On a TV talk show, they sit down for a game of blitz.

phrases.text: Gates gets two minutes. Magnus gets thirty seconds.
phrases.say: Gates gets two minutes. Magnus gets... thirty seconds.

phrases.text: Magnus moves so fast he knocks over a pawn. Two seconds, gone.
phrases.say: Magnus moves so fast he knocks over a pawn. [laughs] Two seconds, gone.

phrases.text: But Gates is holding his own. He castles.
phrases.say: But Gates is holding his own. He castles.

phrases.text: Then Magnus does something he never does. He leaves a knight hanging. For free.
phrases.say: Then Magnus does something he never does. [whispers] He leaves a knight hanging. For free.

phrases.text: Gates takes the bishop instead. The engine says he's winning.
phrases.say: Gates takes the bishop instead. The engine says... he's winning.

phrases.text: Then he takes the free knight.
phrases.say: Then he takes the free knight.

phrases.text: Nine moves. Magnus used twelve of his thirty seconds.
phrases.say: Nine moves. Magnus used twelve of his thirty seconds.

phrases.text: Gates still had more than a minute on his clock.
phrases.say: Gates still had more than a minute on his clock.

phrases.text: Magnus later admitted he broke his own rule: never win with cheap tricks.
phrases.say: Magnus later admitted he broke his own rule... never win with cheap tricks.

phrases.text: Could you beat Bill Gates? Follow for more.
phrases.say: Could you beat Bill Gates? Follow for more.
